scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix imcam-hub-backend" "npm run dev --prefix imcam-hub-frontend" "npm run dev --prefix imcam-hub-adminpanel"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix imcam-hub-frontend && npm run build --prefix imcam-hub-adminpanel
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix imcam-hub-backend && npm install --prefix imcam-hub-frontend && npm install --prefix imcam-hub-adminpanel
scripts.db:migrate: cd imcam-hub-backend && psql $DATABASE_URL -f migrations/001_initial_schema.sql && psql $DATABASE_URL -f migrations/002_cms_schema.sql && psql $DATABASE_URL -f migrations/003_cases_schema.sql && psql $DATABASE_URL -f migrations/004_documents_schema.sql && psql $DATABASE_URL -f migrations/002_cms_seed.sql
